notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello all!

This should fix all the crash issues with achievements. Sorry again that this went untended for a bit, we'll keep a sharper eye on the crash report discussion thread from now on.

Have a squishy weekend!

Squidlit Ink.

notes.title: Achievements causing crashing
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've just noticed an issue with the Steam Achievement code causing a hard crash every time it activates thanks to your comments. We'll be reviewing this and releasing a fix this weekend as fast as we can.

The game engine we use has changed the code that communicates with the Steam platform. We'll be going through and altering all our code that handles this communication in order to fix the issue.

Please bear with us while we deal with this. We're terribly sorry for any and all inconveniences this causes you!

Have a squishy weekend,
~Sam and Alex Barrett

notes.title: Patch v1.00.4
notes.notes:
Hello! Some minor updates for all you squishies out there.

[list]
[*]The Muffin spiders have received extra feign death lessons, and will now fake it like a pro.
[*]Fweehoo would sometimes leave mid-conversation. We've told them that is rude, so that shouldn't happen anymore.
[*]The residents of Squishu were very camera shy, but have gained a lot of confidence recently. Taking screenshots through Steam should work properly now.
[/list]

Have a squishy day!

notes.title: Achievements now work!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Sorry it took us a while to get achievements working! We tried a newer method of uploading the file to Steam and that turned out to be the issue. You may have noticed several un-announced patches, which were the squidlits trying different things to see if achievements were activating. 

Unfortunately achievements are not retroactive, but Skwit Skwot told us that she's archived a log of your valiant deeds in her royal library. We've also fixed other bugs that were reported to us on Twitter, Steam Discussions, and the Squidlit Fan Community Discord! 

Thank you all for your help!
Have a squishy day!

~Alex, Sam, and the squidlits.
